answer: Propose one AI vote/key/day at a ferrous-recycling summit for retaining 1 TiB of independent, key-bound random data issued by verifiers. They sample 64 independent random blocks/day; wrong or late replies deny the vote, exposing hollow storage claims. Assume honest issuers and deadlines preventing on-demand reconstruction. Disks are reusable capital; power recurs; no stake is locked. Shared hosts, outsourcing and parallel keys cannot deduplicate random data. Wealth buys aliases. Ten compliant keys need 10 TiB; a key storing half passes with probability 2^-64.
